title: Are You Suffering From Religious Trauma

top_liked.author: @hunterbidenslaptops
top_liked.text: Bruh, crazy thing is I'm like "Yes" I didn't even start the video. I just KNOW I'm suffering from religious trauma. I'm trying to find ways to explain it to my family who are dedicated believers.

top_liked.author: @kaceesnow
top_liked.text: Not suffering from religious trauma from past experiences.  But suffering from Religious people, making my life a living hell

top_liked.author: @carltoncoleman454
top_liked.text: I've been through religious trauma as a gay atheist who has even tried to return to the faith.  The striving of being or doing something that suppresses your nature is toxic to the mind and body.  Religion makes you hate and deprecate yourself just for being human.  It's not…

top_liked.author: @somethingyousaid5059
top_liked.text:
Fundamentally, trauma is existential. After all, if you don't exist, you can't be traumatized by religion or by anything else.
Existence is the human being's first and worst problem.
